architecture:
Relic is a zero-knowledge publication system where the publisher client (`relic-mcp`) encrypts content client-side using RFC 8188 AES-128-GCM before uploading ciphertext directly to Google Cloud Storage under a pre-signed V4 PUT grant. The decryption key lives exclusively in the URL fragment (#key) on the client side and is never transmitted to the server.

The server (`relic-server`) is a Bun HTTP service running on Cloud Run. It does not use a relational SQL database; instead, relic metadata rows are stored as JSON documents directly in GCS (`gcsStore`, under prefix `m/relic/${id}.json`). For link unfurls, `/{id}` serves a static HTML shell with server-rendered Open Graph and Twitter tags. Currently, `og:image` serves a single constant raster (`/assets/card.v1.png`) with immutable caching headers. Introducing per-relic OG cover images touches the client publisher (`relic-mcp` for rendering and upload), server storage/schema (`RelicStore` for image blob storage/URL reference), and the shell OG generator (`app.ts:2151`).

report: # Code Path Mapping: Per-Relic OG Cover Image Investigation conducted in worktree `.claude/worktrees/og-cover-image` (commit `origin/main`). --- ## 1. Publish Flow End to End (Publish and Republish) ### Publish Flow (`relic_publish`) 1. **Source File Ingestion**: - `packages/relic-mcp/src/publish.ts:277`: ```ts const source = await readSource(input.path, deps.files); ``` - In `readSource` (`packages/relic-mcp/src/publish.ts:510-549`), `files.stat()` verifies the path is a regular file (rejects directory with `source_is_directory` at line 524, rejects FIFO/socket with `source_not_regular_file` at line 534), then reads raw bytes via `bytes = await files.read(resolvedPath)`. 2. **Prior-Publish Lookup**: - `packages/relic-mcp/src/publish.ts:278-301`: Resolves Git/inode identity and checks local state file. If published previously and `force_new !== true`, throws `source_already_published`. 3. **Challenge Precheck**: - `packages/relic-mcp/src/publish.ts:308-312`: ```ts const challenge = await postJson(deps, `${deps.serviceOrigin}/api/challenge`, {}); ``` - Checks `source.bytes.length > sizeLimit` (lines 316-327), throwing `local_size_precheck_failed` if oversized. 4. **Renderer Class & Title Derivation**: - `packages/relic-mcp/src/publish.ts:330`: ```ts const filename = input.filename ?? source.basename; const normalizedTitle = normalizeTitle(input.title ?? filename); ``` - `packages/relic-mcp/src/publish.ts:335`: ```ts const rendererClass = deriveRendererClass(source.bytes, filename); ``` - In `packages/relic-format/src/renderer-class.ts:388-418`: - Checks empty content (`content.length === 0 ? 'binary'`). - Sniffs magic byte signatures (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, ZIP, GZIP, BZIP2, XZ, ZSTD, TAR, 7Z, PDF, MP4, WebM, OGG, MP3, WAV, FLAC). - Checks file extension mapping in `EXTENSIONS`. - Checks text prefix (`HTML_PREFIXES` -> `html`, else `code`). - Fallback: `binary`. 5. **Key Generation and Container Encryption**: - `packages/relic-mcp/src/publish.ts:352-353`: ```ts const relicId = generateRelicId(); const key = generateKey(); ``` - `packages/relic-mcp/src/publish.ts:358-363`: ```ts const container = await encryptRelic({ content: source.bytes, filename, mimetype: guessMimetype(filename, rendererClass), key, }); ``` - `encryptRelic` in `packages/relic-format/src/container.ts:52-103` encrypts using RFC 8188 AES-128-GCM, placing the filename and mimetype inside encrypted Record 0. 6. **Grant Request (`POST /api/grant`)**: - `packages/relic-mcp/src/publish.ts:367-379`: ```ts grant = await postJson(deps, `${deps.serviceOrigin}/api/grant`, { challenge_nonce: challenge['challenge_nonce'], relic_id: relicId, renderer_class: rendererClass, publishing_client: deps.clientName, declared_size_bytes: source.bytes.length, declared_ciphertext_bytes: container.length, title: normalizedTitle, ...(input.ttl_days === undefined ? {} : { ttl_days: input.ttl_days }), }); ``` - Plaintext `title` travels directly as the JSON string `normalizedTitle` (defaulting to source filename). - Renderer class travels as coarse string `renderer_class` (`RendererClass`). 7. **Direct Ciphertext Upload & Confirmation**: - `packages/relic-mcp/src/publish.ts:409-410`: ```ts await putContainer(deps, relicId, String(grant['upload_url']), container); await reportComplete(deps, relicId); ``` - `putContainer` (`packages/relic-mcp/src/publish.ts:678-682`) issues `PUT` directly to GCS signed URL with pinned `content-length`. - `reportComplete` (`packages/relic-mcp/src/publish.ts:708-711`) calls `POST /api/relics/${relicId}/complete`. 8. **Local State Persistence**: - `packages/relic-mcp/src/publish.ts:430-439`: Writes `key`, `publish_token`, `version: 1`, `source`, `filename`, `content_sha256` to disk (`savePublishState`). ### Republish Flow (`relic_republish`) - `packages/relic-mcp/src/republish.ts:108-395`: - Validates `isValidRelicId(input.relic_id)` (line 116). - Loads local publish state (`loadPublishState`, line 126); fails with `no_local_publish_state` if not found. - Reads source file and computes `contentDigest` (lines 196-206); refuses duplicate content with `duplicate_version` (line 208). - Comment Gate: calls `readComments(input.relic_id, deps, { version: '*' })` (line 231); refuses with `unaddressed_comments` if any comments remain open or unreadable (line 271). - Encrypts using the **original key** decoded from local state: - `packages/relic-mcp/src/republish.ts:302-307`: `key: decodeKey(state.key)` ensures existing URL fragment continues to decrypt. - Request Grant (`POST /api/relics/:id/republish`): - `packages/relic-mcp/src/republish.ts:312-323`: ```ts const grant = await postJson(deps, `${deps.serviceOrigin}/api/relics/${input.relic_id}/republish`, { publish_token: state.publish_token, renderer_class: rendererClass, declared_size_bytes: source.bytes.length, declared_ciphertext_bytes: container.length, title: normalizedTitle, ...(input.ttl_days === undefined ? {} : { ttl_days: input.ttl_days }), }); ``` - PUTs container to `grant['upload_url']` and calls `reportComplete`. - Increments local `version: state.version + 1` in local state (lines 339-351). --- ## 2. Server Storage and State ### Database Engine & Schema - **No relational SQL database exists** (no SQLite, Postgres, or migration files). - Production storage is GCS JSON documents via `gcsStore` (`packages/relic-server/src/gcsstore.ts:11-19`): > "GCS rather than a database, because the deployment already has a bucket, an attached identity, and no other stateful dependency." - Test/local storage is in-memory `MemoryStore` (`packages/relic-server/src/store.ts:354-366`). - Paths in GCS bucket (`packages/relic-server/src/gcsstore.ts:99-100`): - Relic metadata rows: `m/relic/${id}.json` (`packages/relic-server/src/gcsstore.ts:220`) - Tombstones: `m/tomb/${id}.json` (`packages/relic-server/src/gcsstore.ts:285`) - Challenges: `m/challenge/${nonce}.json` (`packages/relic-server/src/gcsstore.ts:301`) - Comments: `m/comment/${relicId}/${commentId}.json` (`packages/relic-server/src/gcsstore.ts:401`) ### Ciphertext Blobs - Live in GCS object storage managed by `gcsStorage` (`packages/relic-server/src/gcs.ts:354-458`). - Object key in bucket is `${prefix}/${relicId}` or `${relicId}` (`packages/relic-server/src/gcs.ts:359`). - Access is strictly via V4 Signed URLs: `signUpload` generates `PUT` URLs; `signDownload` generates `GET` URLs. The app server never proxies ciphertext bytes. ### Title and Renderer Class Storage & Clearing - Fields on `RelicRow` (`packages/relic-server/src/store.ts:29, 57`): ```ts readonly rendererClass: RendererClass; title?: string | undefined; ``` - Stored upon initial `putRelic` from `/api/grant`. - Updated upon republish via `beginVersion` (`packages/relic-server/src/gcsstore.ts:253-264`): ```ts title: titleUpdate !== undefined ? titleUpdate.title : row.title ``` Passing an empty title clears the field to `undefined`. - Tombstoning/Removal (`packages/relic-server/src/store.ts:55-56, 65-76`): The `Tombstone` interface holds `rendererClass` but **deliberately omits `title`**. When removed, `m/relic/${id}.json` is deleted and the tombstone retains only `ciphertextHash` and metadata. ### Upload Size Limits - Plaintext cap: `PLAINTEXT_CAP_BYTES = 100 * 1024 * 1024` (100 MB, `packages/relic-format/src/container.ts:40`). - Ciphertext cap: calculated by `ciphertextCapBytes()` (`packages/relic-format/src/container.ts:274-276`) = `encryptedSize(PLAINTEXT_CAP_BYTES, rs)` with `RECORD_SIZE = 64 * 1024`. - Enforced at: - Local client precheck (`packages/relic-mcp/src/publish.ts:316`). - Container encryptor (`packages/relic-format/src/container.ts:58-60`). - Server grant endpoint (`packages/relic-server/src/app.ts:439-455`). - GCS signed PUT URL pinning exact `content-length` header (`packages/relic-server/src/gcs.ts:397`). --- ## 3. Shell OG Tags and Asset Serving ### OG Tags Construction (`/{id}`) - Handled by `shell(config, target, store, now)` in `packages/relic-server/src/app.ts:2101-2217`. - Looks up relic state (`packages/relic-server/src/app.ts:2119-2141`): ```ts const tombstone = await store.getTombstone(canonicalId); if (tombstone === undefined) { const row = await store.getRelic(canonicalId); if (row !== undefined) { const isExpired = row.expiresAt !== undefined && now >= row.expiresAt; if (!isExpired) { storedRendererClass = row.rendererClass; if (row.title !== undefined && row.title.length > 0) { storedTitle = row.title; } } } } ``` - Fallback for Tombstoned / Expired / Unknown / Failed Relics: - If tombstone exists, row is missing, expired, or store throws, `storedTitle` and `storedRendererClass` remain `undefined` (`packages/relic-server/src/app.ts:2136-2140`). - `card = cardCopy(storedRendererClass)` (`packages/relic-server/src/card.ts:89-95`): when `rendererClass === undefined`, falls back to `FALLBACK_TITLE = 'A relic'` and `CARD_DESCRIPTION = 'An encrypted file. It opens in your browser...'`. - `cardTitle = storedTitle ?? card.title` (`packages/relic-server/src/app.ts:2153`). - Serving Image URL: - `packages/relic-server/src/app.ts:2151`: ```ts const ogImage = `${serviceOrigin}/assets/card.v1.png`; ``` - Rendered meta tags (`packages/relic-server/src/app.ts:2174-2185`): ```html ``` ### Asset Serving & Cache Headers (`/assets/card.v1.png`) - Route dispatch: `packages/relic-server/src/app.ts:186-187`: ```ts if (head === 'assets') return serveAsset(segments.slice(1).join('/'), request); ``` - Serving in `serveAsset` (`packages/relic-server/src/app.ts:251-260`): ```ts if (name.endsWith('.png')) { return new Response(asset.body as unknown as BodyInit, { headers: { 'content-type': asset.contentType, 'cache-control': 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable', 'referrer-policy': 'no-referrer', 'x-content-type-options': 'nosniff', }, }); } ``` - Sourced from disk or memory via `packages/relic-server/src/assets.ts:44-69` (`diskAssets`). --- ## 4. Publisher Rendering Capability (`relic-mcp`) ### Dependencies and Rendering Tools - Does `relic-mcp` have ANY rendering/browser/imaging dependencies (playwright, puppeteer, sharp, satori, resvg, canvas)? **NO.** None whatsoever. - Verbatim `dependencies` in `packages/relic-mcp/package.json`: - `"dependencies"` field is **completely absent** (zero runtime npm dependencies). - Verbatim `devDependencies` (`packages/relic-mcp/package.json:46-49`): ```json "devDependencies": { "@relic/format": "workspace:*", "@relic/server": "workspace:*" } ``` ### Build and Distribution - Built with Bun (`packages/relic-mcp/package.json:44`: `"build": "bun run build.ts"`). - Target runtime: Node.js 18+ (`packages/relic-mcp/package.json:11-13`: `"engines": { "node": ">=18" }`). - Bundler logic (`packages/relic-mcp/build.ts:32-48`): ```ts const built = await Bun.build({ entrypoints: ['./src/index.ts'], outdir: out, target: 'node', format: 'esm', minify: false, splitting: false, naming: 'relic-mcp.js', define: { 'process.env.RELIC_MCP_VERSION': JSON.stringify(pkg.version) }, }); ``` - Shebang and distribution: - `packages/relic-mcp/src/index.ts:1`: `#!/usr/bin/env node` - Output file: `dist/relic-mcp.js` (`chmod 0o755`). - Executed via `npx relic-mcp` (`"bin": { "relic-mcp": "dist/relic-mcp.js" }`). - Also outputs Claude Code plugin manifests to `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` and `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`. --- ## 5. summary: Exhaustive audit of the Relic codebase mapping publish/republish flows, server storage/GCS integration, OG card generation, publisher rendering capabilities, viewer class renderers, card design geometry, and verification pipelines for per-relic OG cover images.
